title: Hai ahle haram me shore buka sheh laate hai lasha
body:
Hai ahle haram me shore buka sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
kehti hai ye ro ro kar fizza sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
jab teere sitam gardan pe laga wo phool sa bacha nehr hua
baacchoo'n me hai saara khoon jama sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
nazdeek koi juz yaas nahi humdard koi bhi paas nahi
hai qaak basar maqtak ki fiza sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
lashe pe nazar farmaate hai chalte hai kabhi ruk jaate hai
aata hai tasawwur banu ka sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
jo wazn me tha asghar se siwa, wo teer jo tha asghar se bada
Us teer se hai hulqoom chida sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
nanha sa hai kurta qoon me tar aur sookhi zaba'n hai hoto'n par
gardan hai chidi manka hai dhala sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
pehle hi musibat ki thi ghadi aur us pe qayamat ye guzri
khat aaya hai 'razvi' soughra ka sheh laate hai lasha asghar ka
